theme.en: Memory and packaging reset AI economics
theme.zh: 存储与封装重塑AI经济性

dek.en: HBM availability, 3D integration and system-memory costs are moving from component details to constraints on AI deployment. Foundries and challengers alike are responding with capacity, packaging and financing decisions.
dek.zh: HBM供给、3D集成和系统级存储成本，正从零部件细节变为AI部署的硬约束。晶圆厂与新兴挑战者都在以产能、封装和融资决策回应这一变化。

title.en: AI & Accelerators
title.zh: AI与加速器

title.en: NVIDIA's Kyber rack memory bill comes into view
title.zh: NVIDIA Kyber机架的存储成本浮出水面

summary.en: A report puts NVIDIA's planned Vera Rubin Ultra Kyber rack at 340.4 TB of DRAM and estimates a $41.6 million price per rack, with HBM4E at $19.76 per GB. The figures are not company guidance, but they illustrate how memory and interconnect choices can dominate the bill of materials for next-generation AI systems.
summary.zh: 一篇报道估计，NVIDIA规划中的Vera Rubin Ultra Kyber机架将配备340.4 TB DRAM，单机架价格约4160万美元，HBM4E单价约19.76美元/GB。这些数字并非公司指引，但显示在下一代AI系统中，存储和互连配置可能主导物料成本。

title.en: Foundry & Manufacturing
title.zh: 晶圆代工与制造

title.en: TSMC targets a one-year 3DIC development cycle
title.zh: 台积电瞄准一年期3DIC开发周期

summary.en: TSMC is addressing CoWoS material risks while seeking to compress its 3DIC development cycle to one year, according to DigiTimes. Faster iteration in advanced packaging matters because CoWoS and related 3D integration technologies have become a practical limiter on AI-accelerator delivery, not merely an add-on to logic manufacturing.
summary.zh: 据DigiTimes报道，台积电正应对CoWoS材料风险，并力争将3DIC开发周期压缩至一年。先进封装更快迭代具有关键意义，因为CoWoS及相关3D集成技术已成为AI加速器交付的实际制约，而不再只是逻辑制造的附加环节。

title.en: Sony Semiconductor and TSMC plan ¥747 billion sensor investment
title.zh: 索尼半导体与台积电计划投资7470亿日元开发传感器

summary.en: Sony Semiconductor and TSMC are reported to invest ¥747 billion in next-generation image sensors. The proposed commitment would extend their manufacturing partnership beyond conventional sensor supply and underscores the growing capital intensity of advanced imaging as automotive and edge-AI demand broadens.
summary.zh: 报道称，索尼半导体和台积电将向下一代图像传感器投资7470亿日元。这项拟议投资将把双方合作从传统传感器供给延伸到更深层的制造协同，也凸显汽车和边缘AI需求扩展后先进成像领域不断上升的资本强度。

title.en: Memory
title.zh: 存储

title.en: HBM supply constraints shift attention to utilization
title.zh: HBM供给约束使焦点转向利用效率

summary.en: HBM supply is reportedly reaching limits, shifting the memory contest from peak bandwidth toward how effectively capacity is allocated and used. For accelerator vendors and cloud operators, that makes software scheduling, packaging yields and usable memory per system as consequential as headline bandwidth specifications.
summary.zh: 报道称，HBM供给正触及上限，存储竞争的重点从峰值带宽转向容量能否被有效分配和利用。对加速器厂商和云运营商而言，软件调度、封装良率以及每套系统的可用存储量，正变得与标称带宽同样重要。

title.en: CXMT reportedly reaches 90% yield on 17 nm DDR5
title.zh: 报道称长鑫存储17nm DDR5良率达到90%

summary.en: Chinese memory maker CXMT has reportedly achieved a 90% yield on DDR5 chips made on its 17 nm process. If sustained in volume production, that result would strengthen its ability to supply the domestic market during a global memory shortage and narrow the manufacturing gap with established DRAM suppliers.
summary.zh: 报道称，中国存储厂商长鑫存储的17nm DDR5芯片良率已达到90%。若能在量产中维持这一水平，该成果将增强其在全球存储紧张期间服务国内市场的能力，并缩小与成熟DRAM供应商之间的制造差距。

title.en: Equipment & Materials
title.zh: 设备与材料

title.en: Samsung delays High-NA EUV toward its 1 nm node
title.zh: 三星将High-NA EUV推迟至1nm节点

summary.en: Samsung is reportedly planning to reserve ASML's High-NA EUV tools for 1 nm volume production, potentially as early as 2030, rather than introduce them sooner. The delay aligns it with TSMC's cautious rollout and shows that tool availability alone does not settle the economics, process maturity and throughput trade-offs of High-NA lithography.
summary.zh: 报道称，三星计划将ASML的High-NA EUV设备留待1nm节点量产使用，最早可能在2030年，而非更早导入。这一延后与台积电的谨慎部署相呼应，表明即使设备可得，High-NA光刻的经济性、工艺成熟度和吞吐量取舍仍未定论。

title.en: Policy & Geopolitics
title.zh: 政策与地缘政治

title.en: China risk shadows NVIDIA's proposed $500 billion financing plan
title.zh: 中国风险笼罩NVIDIA拟议5000亿美元融资计划

summary.en: CNBC examines how China-related risks could complicate Jensen Huang's reported $500 billion AI financing plan. The story links financing ambition to the export-control environment: restrictions on market access and product eligibility can affect the demand assumptions behind large-scale AI infrastructure commitments.
summary.zh: CNBC分析称，与中国相关的风险可能使黄仁勋据报提出的5000亿美元AI融资计划更为复杂。报道将融资雄心与出口管制环境联系起来：市场准入和产品资格限制会影响大规模AI基础设施投入所依赖的需求假设。

title.en: Survey questions strategic return from US export controls
title.zh: 调查质疑美国出口管制的战略回报

summary.en: A survey reported by the South China Morning Post argues that US export controls have produced no strategic gain while hurting American firms. It is an industry view rather than a policy finding, but it highlights the persistent debate over whether restrictions change technology access faster than they redirect supply chains and R&D spending.
summary.zh: 《南华早报》报道的一项调查认为，美国出口管制未带来战略收益，却损害了美国企业利益。这是产业界观点而非政策结论，但它凸显了长期争论：限制措施究竟能否比供应链和研发投入的重定向更快地改变技术获取。

title.en: Earnings & Markets
title.zh: 业绩与市场

title.en: Global semiconductor sales rise 35.1% in Q2
title.zh: 全球半导体销售额二季度增长35.1%

summary.en: Global semiconductor sales increased 35.1% in the second quarter of 2026, according to the reported industry tally. The growth rate provides a broad demand backdrop for capacity and equipment decisions, though it does not by itself show how gains are divided between AI, memory, automotive and consumer markets.
summary.zh: 据报道的行业统计，2026年第二季度全球半导体销售额增长35.1%。这一增速为产能和设备决策提供了广泛的需求背景，但本身并不能说明AI、存储、汽车和消费市场之间如何分配增长。

title.en: Challengers
title.zh: 挑战者

title.en: Korea's Rebellions raises $640 million at a $2.6 billion valuation
title.zh: 韩国Rebellions以26亿美元估值融资6.4亿美元

summary.en: Korean AI-chip company Rebellions has reportedly raised $640 million at a $2.6 billion valuation. The capital gives the company more runway to develop and deploy inference hardware, but competing with NVIDIA still depends on software compatibility, customer qualification and access to advanced packaging and memory.
summary.zh: 据报道，韩国AI芯片公司Rebellions以26亿美元估值融资6.4亿美元。这笔资金为其开发和部署推理硬件提供了更长的周期，但能否与NVIDIA竞争仍取决于软件兼容性、客户认证以及先进封装和存储的获取能力。

theme.en: Memory hierarchy becomes the inference design point
theme.zh: 存储层级成为推理设计的核心

dek.en: This week's systems work shifts KV caches, LoRA adapters and model weights across HBM, host and pooled memory. Photonics research meanwhile advances manufacturable building blocks for integrated optical systems.
dek.zh: 本周系统研究将KV缓存、LoRA适配器和模型权重重新分配到HBM、主机内存与池化内存之间。同时，光子学研究推进了可制造的集成光学系统基础模块。

title.en: Devices & Process
title.zh: 器件与工艺

title.en: A fully integrated dispersion-managed femtosecond mode-locked laser
title.zh: 全集成色散管理飞秒锁模激光器

papers.authors: Xurong Li, Xuan Yang, Z. Qiu, et al.

summary.en: The authors demonstrate a self-starting integrated mode-locked laser using erbium-implanted silicon-nitride gain waveguides, chirped Bragg gratings and a saturable-absorber mirror. It operates from 0.5 to 1.2 GHz with pulses as short as 300 fs and a 27.3 mW mode-locking threshold, targeting a repetition-rate regime that chip-scale sources have struggled to reach.
summary.zh: 作者展示了一种自启动全集成锁模激光器，采用掺铒氮化硅增益波导、啁啾布拉格光栅和可饱和吸收镜。该器件工作频率为0.5至1.2 GHz，最短脉冲300 fs，锁模阈值27.3 mW，瞄准片上光源长期难以覆盖的低重复频率区间。

title.en: Wafer-scale monolithic Ce:YIG magneto-optical isolators on silicon
title.zh: 硅上晶圆级单片Ce:YIG磁光隔离器

papers.authors: Tianchi Zhang, Yucong Yang, Weihao Yang, et al.

summary.en: This work reports RF-sputtered Ce:YIG films on 4-inch silicon wafers and demonstrates ring-resonator magneto-optical isolators. The films show a 2,318 deg/cm Faraday effect, 80 dB/cm propagation loss and 3.5% thickness uniformity; the result addresses a key scale-up obstacle for nonreciprocal silicon-photonic components.
summary.zh: 该工作报告了在4英寸硅晶圆上通过射频溅射制备Ce:YIG薄膜，并演示环形谐振器磁光隔离器。薄膜的法拉第旋转为2318 deg/cm、传播损耗80 dB/cm、厚度均匀性3.5%，直指非互易硅光子器件规模化的一项关键障碍。

title.en: Systems & Architecture
title.zh: 系统与架构

title.en: FlashBoot: Sub-second weight loading for rack-scale large models
title.zh: FlashBoot：机架级大模型的亚秒级权重加载

papers.authors: Issac Zhu, Hscos Zhang, Ke Jiang, et al.

summary.en: FlashBoot redesigns model bring-up around an exportable contiguous tensor layout, bulk zero-copy host transfers and remote GPU cloning. The paper argues that existing loaders waste fabric bandwidth through fragmented tensors and 10–110 second NCCL setup, making this work relevant to elastic MoE serving where racks must become ready quickly.
summary.zh: FlashBoot围绕可导出的连续张量布局、批量零拷贝主机传输和远程GPU克隆重新设计模型启动流程。论文指出，现有加载器因张量碎片化以及10至110秒的NCCL初始化而浪费互连带宽，因此对需要快速就绪的弹性MoE机架服务具有现实意义。

title.en: InSituANN: PCIe-efficient billion-scale vector search
title.zh: InSituANN：高PCIe效率的十亿级向量检索

papers.authors: Yuemeng Xu, Zongxi Liu, Junyu Long, et al.

summary.en: InSituANN keeps base vectors in host memory, performs fine search in place and uses a GPU for compact routing and optional pruning, avoiding PCIe transfers of high-dimensional vectors. On SIFT-1B, it reports a 5.2-minute IVF index build, about 350 times faster than the cited comparison, making retrieval infrastructure less dependent on GPU-resident capacity.
summary.zh: InSituANN将原始向量保留在主机内存中原位执行精细检索，并以GPU处理紧凑路由和可选剪枝，从而避免经PCIe传输高维基础向量。在SIFT-1B上，它报告5.2分钟完成IVF索引构建，约为论文对比方案的350倍，使检索基础设施对GPU常驻容量的依赖更低。

title.en: AI Accelerators & Compute-in-Memory
title.zh: AI加速器与存算一体

title.en: PLoRA: NDP-enhanced pooled memory for Multi-LoRA serving
title.zh: PLoRA：面向多LoRA服务的NDP增强池化内存

papers.authors: Zhongkai Yu, O. Venkatachalam, Zheng Wang, et al.

summary.en: PLoRA proposes a pooled-memory serving design that keeps LoRA adapters and KV cache in the pool, using near-data processing to return reduced results rather than moving all data to the GPU. It addresses deployments with thousands of adapters, where CPU-DRAM staging over PCIe consumes both capacity and kernel-launch overhead; its benefit depends on the availability of memory-semantic fabrics and NDP support.
summary.zh: PLoRA提出一种池化内存服务设计，将LoRA适配器和KV缓存留在内存池中，通过近数据处理只返回归约结果，而非把全部数据搬到GPU。它针对拥有数千个适配器的部署场景，解决CPU DRAM经PCIe调入所造成的容量和内核启动开销；其收益仍取决于具备内存语义的互连和NDP支持。

title.en: Phase-change microring nonlinear activations for photonic neural networks
title.zh: 用于光子神经网络的相变微环非线性激活

papers.authors: Wentao Zhong, Yida Dong, Wenlu Zhong, et al.

summary.en: A GST superlattice on a silicon microring is used to demonstrate five reconfigurable nonlinear activation functions, including ReLU and softplus. The device reaches a 1.76 mW activation threshold and up to 1 MHz operation; a system-level MNIST experiment improves reported accuracy from 95.35% to 99.24%, though that benchmark does not establish an end-to-end optical-compute advantage.
summary.zh: 研究在硅微环上集成GST超晶格，演示了包括ReLU和softplus在内的五种可重构非线性激活函数。器件激活阈值为1.76 mW、最高工作速度1 MHz；系统级MNIST实验报告准确率从95.35%升至99.24%，但这一基准尚不足以证明端到端光计算优势。

title.en: AI Systems & Inference
title.zh: AI系统与推理

title.en: OasisKV: Lookahead sparse prefetching beyond HBM
title.zh: OasisKV：突破HBM容量的前瞻稀疏预取

papers.authors: Can Xiao, Sukmin Cho, Junbong We, et al.

summary.en: OasisKV decouples full KV-cache storage from HBM during LLM decoding, retaining only predicted-relevant entries in HBM and prefetching blocks from higher-capacity tiers. Built on vLLM, it uses speculative-decoding lookahead to predict future important tokens, offering a systems path to larger contexts without assuming that all KV state fits on the accelerator.
summary.zh: OasisKV在LLM解码期间将完整KV缓存存储与HBM解耦，只将预测为相关的条目保留在HBM中，并从更大容量的层级预取数据块。该系统基于vLLM，利用推测解码的前瞻信息预测未来重要token，为更长上下文提供了一条不要求所有KV状态都装入加速器的系统路径。

title.en: HiSparse: Hierarchical KV cache management for sparse-attention decoding
title.zh: HiSparse：面向稀疏注意力解码的分层KV缓存管理

papers.authors: Zhiqiang Xie, Zhangheng Huang, Ting-Jun Huang, et al.

summary.en: HiSparse keeps full KV history in host memory while bounding each request's GPU footprint with a fixed-size cache, preserving exact model outputs for sparse-attention methods. Its fused CUDA path combines hit detection, replacement and host-device fetches inside the decode graph, and the authors evaluate it on H200, B200 and GH200 systems; the approach is most applicable when sparse selection remains effective.
summary.zh: HiSparse将完整KV历史保留在主机内存中，同时以固定大小的GPU缓存限制每个请求的显存占用，并保持稀疏注意力方法的模型输出精确一致。其融合CUDA路径在解码图内完成命中检测、替换和主机至设备取数，作者在H200、B200和GH200系统上评估；该方法最适合稀疏选择仍有效的场景。

title.en: Output-aware rotation for INT2 KV-cache quantization
title.zh: 面向输出的INT2 KV缓存旋转量化

papers.authors: Vincent-Daniel Yun, Woosang Lim, Minsoo Cheong, et al.

summary.en: OptR learns per-head orthogonal corrections for INT2 KV-cache quantization by minimizing error after attention and the output projection, rather than optimizing a pre-output proxy. Across three models and five reasoning and coding benchmarks, it improves on QuaRot and OSCAR while retaining a paged KV-cache format with negligible stated overhead, making the method relevant where two-bit cache compression is necessary.
summary.zh: OptR通过最小化注意力和输出投影之后的误差，为INT2 KV缓存量化学习逐头正交校正，而不是优化输出前的代理误差。它在三种模型、五项推理与编程基准上优于QuaRot和OSCAR，同时保留分页KV缓存格式且声称开销可忽略，适用于必须采用2比特缓存压缩的场景。
